moves.name: Vulnerable Spores
moves.notes: Has a 3-turn cooldown after use. Special case: if the previous three moves were Vulnerable Spores -> Frail Spores -> Smash, the next turn falls back to Vulnerable Spores because the other branches are all blocked.

moves.name: Frail Spores
moves.notes: Has a 2-turn cooldown after use. Always used at the start of combat.

moves.name: Smash
moves.notes: Cannot be used on consecutive turns. Always used at the start of combat.
